transcript:
In the library window, double-click to open the Practice Files folder.  
Find the E-Connected Empower Sleeve Simulation file in E-Fixes.  
Double-click on the Connected Empower Sleeve Simulation file.  
Or insert it into the 2D or 3D window.  
Open the simulation. The sleeve near the wrist is not suitable for wearing after the simulation.  
Press A.  
In the 3D toolbar, select the Connected Empower Sleeve tool.  
In the 2D and 3D windows, the grid will be displayed in blue.  
If you need to make a precise selection, you can select the grid near the incorrect wearing.  
The grid in the selected area will be displayed in green.  
In the 2D window, you can check it at the same time.  
Use the 3D tool in the selected grid to select the grid near the selected grid.  
Press Shift to select more.  
In the 3D window, use the positioning tool to move it.  
Press A to make it wrap around the model wrist.  
Press B.  
Open the file and take a look at the 3D window.  
Press B to make it open.  
Press A.  
In the 3D window, select the 3D model and use the positioning tool.  
Use the positioning ball tool to rotate and move the sleeve plate to ensure that the sleeve plate is completely wrapped around the wrist of the virtual model.  
Do the same on the other side.  
Do the same on the other side.  
The sleeve will be wrapped around the wrist of the virtual model.  
Same for the other side.  
Move the sleeve at the beginning of each part and place it on the sleeve.

chunks.content: ## Opening and Accessing Sleeve Simulation Files in CLO This section explains how to locate and open the Connected Empower Sleeve Simulation file within CLO’s Practice Files for sleeve fitting adjustments. It covers file navigation and initial setup in both 2D and 3D windows. - In the library window, double-click the **Practice Files** folder. - Navigate to **E-Fixes** and find the file named **Connected Empower Sleeve Simulation**. - Open the file by double-clicking or inserting it into either the 2D or 3D window. - Launch the simulation to observe the sleeve near the wrist for fit issues after simulation. ## Selecting and Adjusting Sleeve Areas Using CLO Tools This section details the use of CLO’s 3D toolbar tools for selecting specific sleeve grid areas that are improperly fitted, and how to adjust them precisely. - Press **A** to activate the selection. - In the 3D toolbar, select the **Connected Empower Sleeve tool**. - The grid will appear blue in both 2D and 3D windows. - Select the grid near the incorrectly worn sleeve area; the selected grid turns green for precision. - Use the 3D window alongside the 2D window to confirm selection accuracy. - Hold **Shift** to select multiple grids near the problem area. - Use the positioning tool in the 3D window to move the selected grids as needed. ## Wrapping the Sleeve Around the Model Wrist This section explains the procedure to wrap the sleeve correctly around the virtual model’s wrist in CLO using positioning and rotation tools. - After adjusting the grids, press **A** to wrap the sleeve around the wrist. - Press **B** to open the sleeve further if needed. - Select the 3D model and activate the positioning ball tool. - Rotate and move the sleeve plate carefully to ensure it fully wraps around the wrist of the virtual model. - Repeat the same adjustment process on the opposite sleeve to maintain symmetry. ## Final Sleeve Placement and Fixing This section covers fine-tuning the sleeve placement on the model, focusing on aligning sleeve edges and fixing the sleeve position relative to specific garment landmarks. - Move the sleeve to the starting position at the beginning of each sleeve part. - Place the sleeve precisely on the sleeve edge. - To fix the sleeve on the front side of the ball tree (a structural component in CLO representing sleeve pivot points), adjust the sleeve position from the **Drape Wrench point** (front) to the **heel point** (back). - These adjustments ensure the sleeve fits naturally and is secured properly on the virtual model. --- This structured guide provides detailed steps for correcting sleeve fit issues in CLO’s Connected Empower Sleeve Simulation, using selection, positioning, rotation, and fixing tools to achieve an accurate and realistic virtual garment fit.
